description:
Get an independent second opinion on any ChatGPT response, right in the conversation. Qu Review uses a panel of independent AI reviewers to critically examine what ChatGPT told you from multiple angles, then combines their findings into one clear, actionable report.

Each review tells you what's accurate, what might be wrong, what's missing, and what's worth exploring further, along with an easy-to-read scorecard so you can see at a glance how much to trust the answer.

Great for anything where getting it right matters: health questions, financial decisions, school work, professional research, or any time something just doesn't sound right.
